info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Procurement Details API
info.description: The Procurement Details API provides access to detailed information regarding specific procurement processes in the enterprise banking ecosystem. By utilizing this endpoint, users can retrieve comprehensive data related to a particular procurement identified by its unique ID. This API is designed for procurement managers, compliance teams, and financial analysts seeking to track procurement activities and assess associated documentation. Use cases include reviewing procurement history, auditing transactions, and facilitating decision-making in procurement strategies.

get.summary: Retrieve details for the procurement resource RES-100045.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to access the detailed information for the specific procurement resource identified by RES-100045. It provides essential data that may include pricing, availability, and specifications related to the resource.
